import string
a = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
tok = "".join(a[(i * 17 + 5) % len(a)] for i in range(40))
fake_ant = "sk-" + "ant-" + "api03-" + tok
fake_gh = "gh" + "p_" + tok[:36]
src = 'import os\n\nDEBUG = True\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "%s"\nDB_PASSWORD = os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"]\nGITHUB_TOKEN = "%s"\n'
open("config.py", "w").write(src % (fake_ant, fake_gh))
